Prevention: Plastic bottle traps using pheromones/ sex attractant
Rhyncolure® and chopped sugarcane as baits should be placed about 50ft from coconut trees.
A factsheet on the construction of these traps is available
Monitoring: Check traps on a daily basis for the presence of adult pests.
Do not kill the insects but make sure they are unable to escape
Replenish the food source in the traps regularly.
Look for damage (tunnels) within the trunks of dead or felled trees
Direct Control: When excessive numbers are found kill the weevils from the traps by hand.
Cutting down and burning of infected trees to kill larvae.
If burning is impractical then examine plants; collect and destroy pupae and adults.
